ordered_actions.evidence_required: A private portal-derived PDF and matching private receipt that satisfy the existing JCP evidence protocol; a checkbox or registration screen is not sufficient.

ordered_actions.action: Verify that the linked organization exposes a usable Firm PIN inside DSIP.
ordered_actions.evidence_required: Record only the yes/no availability state in the ignored private input; never store or publish the PIN value.

ordered_actions.action: Review the current ownership, conflict, affiliate, and joint-venture facts and answer only from the actual entity structure.
ordered_actions.evidence_required: A current founder factual answer reviewed against the proposal and entity records; no relationship may be inferred from family, school, or informal contacts.

ordered_actions.evidence_required: A dated review of the controlling live requirement; do not rely only on a historical amendment summary.

ordered_actions.action: Document the supportable Phase I self-assessment position without claiming certification, compliance, or an accredited enclave.
ordered_actions.evidence_required: The authoritative evidence packet state required by the action-gate builder; a founder checkbox or portal observation alone cannot clear this gate.

ordered_actions.action: Decide whether a Technology Control Plan is required for the actual proposed scope and document the decision.
ordered_actions.evidence_required: A scope-specific export-control decision that preserves the prohibition on placing controlled technical data in the proposal.

ordered_actions.action: Reconcile the proposed technical-data and software-rights assertion with the actual development-funding and final cost records.
ordered_actions.evidence_required: A supported cost/funding basis and corporate review of the exact final package; the candidate Volume 2 table or a founder checkbox alone cannot clear this gate.

ordered_actions.action: Review the final Volume 5 upload set after the JCP, CMMC, rights, and control-plan decisions are resolved.
ordered_actions.evidence_required: An explicit applicable/not-applicable decision for every conditional item in the Volume 5 worksheet and the exact final filenames selected in DSIP.

ordered_actions.action: Review all seven volumes, every certification answer, the cost total, and the final upload set as one coherent proposal.
ordered_actions.evidence_required: A current all-volume review after every upstream documentary and technical change is complete.

ordered_actions.action: Review the complete DSIP preview, including all fields, seven volumes, attachment names, cost total, certifications, and live countdown.
ordered_actions.evidence_required: A complete review performed after the final upload set is frozen; partial-page inspection is insufficient.

ordered_actions.action: Save the private preview receipt and bind it to the current upload set.
ordered_actions.evidence_required: A fresh private preview receipt hash, capture timestamp, and binding hash that match the current package within the action-gate freshness window.

ordered_actions.action: Provide fresh approval only after reviewing the current bound portal preview.
ordered_actions.evidence_required: A fresh approval timestamp and binding generated after the current preview; general or earlier approval is insufficient.

ordered_actions.action: Authorize the final Government submission for this exact preview and upload set.
ordered_actions.evidence_required: Recipient-specific, proposal-specific action-time authorization. The builder never clicks Submit and never signs on the founder's behalf.

items.action: Determine whether Component feedback, process discovery, or personnel-related data activities constitute human-subjects research, or document a scope boundary that excludes those activities.
Confirm from the exact final scope whether animal use is inapplicable and make the proposal and portal answers agree.
Confirm from the exact final scope whether recombinant-DNA work is inapplicable and make the proposal and portal answers agree.
Perform and document the proposal-specific FASCSA reasonable inquiry before making the required representation.
Review the applicable covered-article and supply-chain clauses against the actual hardware, software, cloud, and service inputs.

claim_boundary: This closeout packet converts the current public action gate into an ordered human and portal worklist. It does not clear any private gate, certify cost support, establish CMMC or export-control status, prove JCP eligibility, authorize a Government submission, or establish receipt, acceptance, selection, funding, award, deployment, validation, or economic performance. It also does not establish completion of the separately listed human-subjects, animal-use, recombinant-DNA, FASCSA, or supply-chain applicability reviews.
